answer: Random liveness pings inside the epoch window: at an unpredictable minute, the node demands a short fresh response keyed to the current kernel of the epoch, and the answer only counts if it lands within ten minutes. A zenith of ten thousand unattended clones cannot wander back in time to answer a ping it never saw, while one honest agent answers in seconds; the cost of staffing a farm around the clock dwarfs the emission it chases.
